input.quote: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant in § 2(a) runs to "Client" only, with no coverage for Client's affiliates or for contractors acting on Client's behalf, and no notice mechanism to add them, so group companies and outsourced providers cannot lawfully use the Interface. The licence is not revocable at will (§ 2(c) runs until termination of the Agreement), so revocability is acceptable; however § 15 (p0080) permits transfer without consent only to a financially responsible affiliate, leaving a successor in an M&A transaction subject to TrueLink's consent, short of the playbook's transferability position. Redline adds affiliates and contractors to the grant and a successor-transfer carve-out; fallback is affiliates added on written notice.

proposal.summary: Extend licence to Client's affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf, and permit transfer to a successor.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the licence to cover Client's affiliates and contractors acting on Client's behalf, since our personnel, group companies and outsourced service providers all need to use the Interface, and we have confirmed the licence and Agreement transfer with the business to a successor in a merger or sale of assets. If broad affiliate coverage is a concern, we can accept affiliates being added on written notice to TrueLink.

ops.oldText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface
ops.newText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client, its affiliates and its contractors acting on Client's behalf a non-exclusive license to use the Interface

ops.oldText: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment by Client to a financially responsible affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or of the business to which this Agreement relates.
